verdict.rationale: Brex's own marketing documents in-product AI features: an AI-powered expense assistant, AI-powered invoice entry and approval automation, and automated GL coding. These are AI suggestions and automation applied to the user's data, but nothing shows AI-generated analytical insights such as spend trends or anomalies surfaced inside the product. The MCP server serves external assistants rather than providing in-product insights, and the HN comments about an LLM demo's errors refer to a blog example, not this feature, so they only lower confidence. Missing for 10: documented AI insights or analytics on spend data, detail on what the expense assistant suggests, and independent or hands-on corroboration of in-product AI quality.
